verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: You shall not take any wife, and you shall have no children in this place.
verses.3: For thus said Jehovah: “Let the trees and their branches be destroyed in this place. Let their mothers who gave birth to them also be destroyed. And let their fathers who raised them also be destroyed in this land.”
verses.4: Those who die in battle will die, and they will not be buried in graves on the surface of the earth. They will remain in their state of death, during times of hunger and thirst. Their bodies will become food for birds in the sky, and a source of death for the land.
verses.5: For behold, the LORD has said, “Do not enter the house of prostitution; do not go to those who do evil. Do not give them anything, for I have gathered my beloved from this people.” Thus says the LORD, “I will show them my kindness and my mercies.”
verses.6: And the great and small ones die in this land; they will not be buried or honored. They will not be remembered, nor will they be remembered at all.
verses.7: And they shall not be buried on the grave as a means of comfort for the dead. Nor shall they be covered with coffins as a way to honor their father and mother.
verses.8: And in the house of drinking, one shall not enter to eat or drink with them.
verses.9: For as Jehovah, the army of Israel’s God, said: “I will come from this place before your eyes and in your time. There will be a sound of joy and celebration, like the sound of a bridegroom’s voice.”
verses.10: And it shall be that when you tell this people all these things, they will say to you, “What does Jehovah have said about us? What great evils has He brought upon us? What sins have we committed against our God?”
verses.11: And you said to them, “Because they abandoned your fathers. Now, say this: Jehovah says! They went away and served other gods. They worshiped them instead of me. They abandoned me, and they did not keep my laws.”
verses.12: And you, your friends, will do what your ancestors did. You follow the whims of evil people, without listening to me at all.
verses.13: And I have taken you away from this land, from the land that you and your ancestors did not know. You served other gods there, day and night. But I will not give you any forgiveness.
verses.14: Therefore, see, days are coming, says the LORD. And it will no longer be said, “The LORD is alive again!” For the LORD has raised up the children of Israel from the land of Egypt.
verses.15: For Jehovah, who brought the children of Israel up from the land of Egypt and from all those lands that they had been driven out of; and who placed them back on their own land, which I gave to their ancestors.
verses.16: I will send many fishermen, says the LORD. And after that, I will send many more fishers from above all mountains and from above all valleys. From the crevices in the rocks as well.
verses.17: For my eyes have not been hidden from all their paths, and they cannot hide from my sight.
verses.18: And I have punished them for their sins and transgressions. Their wickedness has filled my land with their destruction and their evil deeds.
verses.19: Yehovah is powerful and mighty. In times of trouble, nations will come to you from every corner of the earth. They will say, “It’s all a lie! Our ancestors were destroyed by evil forces, and there’s no one who can help us.”
verses.20: May man be made like God, but they are not gods at all.
verses.21: Therefore, I hereby declare to them at this moment that I will show them my hands and my glory. They shall know that my name is Jehovah.
